superseded.notes: The corpus holds seven tildes and this one is absent from all of them, which is a gap rather than a judgement: envs.net has run since September 2019 and is the largest of the tildeverse hosts checked. The reaper is genuinely unstated. The privacy policy is a generic German GDPR template and the terms reserve suspension for violations, so the record says 'no idle policy found' rather than 'no idle policy'. The next thing to establish is whether an account with a single cron and no interactive login survives; nothing on the site says either way. Note the 2026-03-01 shutdown of Matrix and tt-rss and the stated move to a cheaper server: the operator contracts services when costs rise, which is the realistic reliability risk here, not an idle sweep.
